content: VIRAMUNE XR is the trade name for the extended-release formulation of nevirapine, a medication classified as a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI). This drug exhibits antiviral activity specifically against Human Immunodeficiency Virus Type 1 (HIV-1). Chemically, nevirapine belongs to the dipyridodiazepinone class of compounds. The chemical name of nevirapine is 11-cyclopropyl-5,11-dihydro-4-methyl-6H-dipyrido[3,2-b:2',3'-e][1,4]diazepin-6-one. It appears as a white to off-white crystalline powder, with a molecular weight of 266.30 and a molecular formula of C15H14N4O. The structural formula of nevirapine is as follows: [structural formula not included in text]. VIRAMUNE XR tablets are designed for oral administration. Each tablet contains either 100 mg or 400 mg of the active ingredient, nevirapine. The tablets also include the following inactive components: lactose monohydrate, hypromellose, iron oxide, and magnesium stearate.
